species.name: 별사탕 검댕이
species.design: A tiny round black soot sprite from Spirited Away, white eyes, thin little legs carrying one pink star candy above its head.
species.animation: tiny feet step in alternating sequence, arms steady under candy

species.name: 조개집 검댕이
species.design: A black soot sprite peeking from an open pale peach seashell, tiny white eyes and two thin arms visible.
species.animation: arms gently wiggle and shell mantle subtly sways; rigid shell stays anchored

species.name: 찻잔 검댕이
species.design: A tiny black soot sprite peeking out of an old cream porcelain teacup with a teal rim and a small chipped lip.
species.animation: little arms reach and retract and soot fuzz sways; cup remains still

species.name: 구름솜 해파리
species.design: A small fluffy white cloud-shaped jellyfish with a soft pale teal underside and several short flowing translucent tentacles, tiny eyes on its right-facing profile.
species.animation: soft bell gently contracts and releases, tentacles lag smoothly

species.name: 포뇨의 초록 양동이
species.design: Ponyo green plastic bucket, empty, slightly tilted with curved handle, gentle scuffs and a small leaf nearby.
species.animation: static

species.name: 토토로의 우산
species.design: Totoro old dark charcoal umbrella, discarded and resting diagonally on a small stone, worn fabric, bent wooden hooked handle, no character.
species.animation: static

species.name: 고개 갸웃 코다마
species.design: A small white Kodama forest spirit from Princess Mononoke sitting on a little mossy rock, round irregular head, small dark facial holes, clear right-facing three-quarter profile.
species.animation: neck gently tilts while seated torso and rock stay anchored

species.name: 목욕표 나르는 개구리
species.design: Small green frog bathhouse worker from Spirited Away in simple blue work clothes carrying two wooden bath tokens tied by a red cord.
species.animation: short legs alternate stepping and sleeves flutter; head and tokens stable

species.name: 장작 위 꼬마 캘시퍼
species.design: Small orange Calcifer flame from Howls Moving Castle with expressive eyes and a little mouth sitting on one charred log.
species.animation: orange flame tips ripple in sequence, log and central face stable

species.name: 양동이 꼬마 포뇨
species.design: Tiny red fish-form Ponyo with orange hair and a cream face peeking out of a green bucket that floats upright; side-three-quarter view facing right.
species.animation: Ponyo small fins and hair wave and bucket handle rocks subtly, bucket body stable

species.name: 물방울 포뇨
species.design: Ponyo in her recognizable little red fish form with orange bob hair, cream rounded humanlike face and tiny fin arms, cheerful right-facing profile.
species.animation: small tail sweeps and both fin arms gently propel, hair ends flutter

species.name: 불꽃 정령 캘시퍼
species.design: Calcifer orange and golden flame spirit in a small rustic iron hearth with two short burning logs, expressive eyes and mouth facing right.
species.animation: flames stretch and curl with warm light, iron hearth and central face remain stable

species.name: 노을배달부 키키
species.design: Kiki in her black dress and red hair bow riding a brown broom toward screen right, small black cat Jiji seated behind her, modest outfit, side profile.
species.animation: red bow, dress hem and broom bristles trail in current; torso and broom shaft stable

species.name: 가면을 쓴 숲의 아이, 산
species.design: San from Princess Mononoke wearing her red-and-white wolf mask, cream fur cloak over navy modest clothing, holding her spear while standing planted on a little moss rock, right-facing three-quarter profile.
species.animation: fur cloak and hair sway, spear ribbons flutter; both planted feet and torso remain still

species.name: 숲길의 흰 늑대
species.design: A graceful white wolf companion of San from Princess Mononoke, thick cream-white fur, pointed ears, dark eyes, one long tail, calm right-facing side profile.
species.animation: four paws gently paddle in balanced sequence, tail and long fur follow water

species.name: 하울의 마법 약병 상자
species.design: An open old wooden box of Howls magical potion bottles, small jewel-tone glass bottles, brass stoppers and parchment tags without writing, no face.
species.animation: static

species.name: 팔랑이는 종이 식신
species.design: Three small white humanoid paper shikigami cutouts from Spirited Away flying in a compact flock toward screen right, simple folded paper heads and winglike arms, no eyes or drawn faces.
species.animation: paper arms and corners flap in offset sequence, flock spacing stable

species.name: 백룡의 이름, 하쿠
species.design: Haku in his white dragon form from Spirited Away, very long slender white serpentine body, teal mane, two elegant antlers, whiskers and four small legs, head pointing right, elongated horizontal silhouette.
species.animation: long tail undulates behind left, teal mane and whiskers flow in delayed waves; head and chest stable

species.name: 구름배 가오나시
species.design: No-Face from Spirited Away quietly seated in a small warm wooden boat with a soft pale cloud cushion, white mask turned right, flowing black robe draped within the boat.
species.animation: robe edges and hanging boat tassel sway, mask and boat hull stay anchored

species.name: 물결달리는 고양이버스
species.design: The Catbus from My Neighbor Totoro, orange-brown striped cat-shaped bus with many little legs, smiling cat head pointing right and warm cream glowing windows, long tail trailing left, no lettering on destination sign.
species.animation: many legs alternate running in ordered wave, tail sways, rigid bus body and face stable

species.name: 등불 든 가오나시
species.design: No-Face from Spirited Away standing planted with a flowing black robe, white mask turned right, holding a small warm amber paper lantern on a stick, no text.
species.animation: robe hem and lantern tassel drift, lantern gently rocks; mask and central torso remain fixed

species.name: 파도를 부르는 포뇨
species.design: Ponyo in her red dress riding one curling blue fish-shaped wave, orange bob hair, joyful right-facing profile with arms held open, modest childlike character, single coherent wave base.
species.animation: fish-wave tail and crest flow through a smooth loop, dress and hair flutter; face and torso stable

species.name: 구름우산 토토로
species.design: Large recognizable grey Totoro with cream chevron belly holding a fluffy cloud-shaped white umbrella on a wooden handle, small green leaf on head, standing with both feet planted, right-facing three-quarter profile.
species.animation: ear tips twitch, cloud umbrella fringe and leaf sway; body, umbrella handle and feet stay planted

species.name: 연꽃 우산의 오물신
species.design: The round mud-covered bathhouse stink spirit from Spirited Away, gentle muddy brown lumpy body with a small kind right-facing face, small reeds and harmless twigs caught in moss, holding a large green lotus leaf umbrella.
species.animation: lotus leaf rim and dangling reeds ripple; solid seated body stays stable; a few attached clean light beads glimmer

species.name: 하울의 움직이는 성
species.design: Howls Moving Castle, recognizable asymmetrical ramshackle walking mechanical castle with patched metal walls, curved towers, pipes, rusty brass details, birdlike front face pointing screen right, four jointed mechanical legs firmly on the ground plane, red roof and warm amber windows, horizontal side-three-quarter view.
species.animation: four mechanical legs walk in alternating grounded sequence, small hanging parts sway, chimney smoke remains attached and minimal; rigid main building stays at identical height and scale; special frames progressively illuminate windows with warm Calcifer fire
